i.norm:
When a CSV has duplicate header names, {@link CSVRecord#get(String)} must return the value of the last column that uses that header name.

For the input below the headers "A" and "B" each appear twice:

 header: A A B B values: 1 2 5 6

So {@code get("A")} resolves to the second "A" column ("2") and {@code get("B")} resolves to the second "B" column ("6").
